algorithm: budget-safe steady-state evolutionary placement strategy followed by deterministic sequential 3D A* routing with finite-radius cable reservations, future-port approach reservations, hard component keep-outs, explicit oriented cylindrical ports with mandatory straight-on approaches, renderer-equivalent rounded-tube clearance auditing, and a zero-contact publish gate

objective.note: The evolutionary search owns component positions and gland order; a deterministic sequential 3D A* finalizer derives every route. Every component terminal uses an explicit one-way axial approach, future approach corridors are reserved before routing, the lower enclosure band is a device-free breakout gutter, and every accepted cable centerline is reserved at its full rendered radius plus a 1 mm air gap. A renderer-equivalent rounded-tube audit is a hard publish gate: any cable contact, component contact, coincident run or invalid port approach rejects the generated artifact.
